notes: See real part previews in the Workshop and place larger stickers, including a custom race number, on more sides of the car.
Try new paint finishes and fitted parts. Podium crowns match your best confirmed medal.
Event personal bests can recover from a full browser cache without removing pending runs or saved replays.

entries.title: Make the Garage Workshop easier to use
notes: The Garage Workshop now has larger controls, clearer part art, and sticker slots that show which decal is fitted.
The car stays in view beside the Workshop, including on narrow screens.

entries.title: Update garage layers independently and streamline Shop sync
notes: Stickers are front and center in the Workshop. Pick a noticeably different size, or try a new nose badge, tow plate, roof vent, or rear fog lamp.
Car edits update only the parts that change. The Shop remembers your last confirmed balance, and Racer Studio previews show more of your ranking row.

entries.title: Check for updates sooner and equip two Garage stickers
notes: Equip two stickers in different spots and save them with Garage Save.
Update checks happen sooner as you move through menus. The Style Shop and podium details have simpler layouts.

entries.title: Match the native Garage rail and streamline Style Shop
notes: Workshop now uses the Garage options rail. Try larger sticker previews, Double Apex, and Pit Stripe.
Move between the Style Shop, Racer Studio, and Achievements. The Shop shows your last confirmed balance, and podium details close cleanly.

entries.title: Improve Workshop controls and responsive Community Events
notes: Workshop now opens beside the car. Choose sticker placement directly and preview Pit Arrow and Night Grid.
Browse the Style Shop without connecting. Home and Community Events fit smaller screens better, and event rows show their Event RP status.

entries.title: Apply current Workshop designs to archived event replays
notes: Your older event replays now show your current car paint, stickers, and accessories.
Racer profiles with only one medal type now give it a dedicated display. Preview Solar Flare and Tide Mark in the Workshop.

entries.title: Improve Workshop placement and offline browsing
notes: The Garage Workshop now has a side panel, live angles, and more sticker designs with adjustable placement and size.
Browse the Style Shop offline, open podium details, and see cleaner event badges.

entries.title: Add Workshop stickers and restore offline workflow checks
notes: Added body stickers, clearer Workshop unlocks and Shop previews, plus physical cosmetics on eligible personal replays.
Track Wins now starts with the easiest routes, and Uplink Error is available in Extra Tracks.

entries.title: Fix CDN deployment relocation test dependencies
notes: Fixed a release packaging check so the latest update can reach CDN players.

entries.title: Batch saved snapshot checkout for offline benchmarks
notes: Reduced snapshot download overhead for background replay checks.

entries.title: Align cleanup test with sandboxed native browser
notes: Fixed a background replay-check startup issue so saved-run verification can proceed.

entries.title: Add offline replay benchmark and consistency audit
notes: Expanded saved-replay checks to help keep race results and leaderboards fair.

entries.title: Add bounded two-engine offline verification option
notes: Published more verified race results and added an optional two-at-a-time replay check for future verification runs.

entries.title: Reuse native replay validators and remove idle rendering
notes: Reduced repeated replay-verifier startup work while preserving exact physics checks and existing verified results.

entries.title: Speed up snapshot packaging and verification checkpoints
notes: Reduced snapshot preparation, packaging and verification checkpoint overhead while keeping replay checks unchanged.

entries.title: Simplify event points and verification tooltips
notes: Simplified event verification tooltips: run date, verification status and ERP earned.
Kept unverified ERP estimates clearly separate from awarded points.

entries.title: Align weekly details and keep Rolling Hills points in tooltips
notes: Left-aligned the Kodub weekly card and added breathing room between your time and placement.
Rolling Hills verification tooltips now keep the run date, verification status and earned Event RP together.

entries.title: Restore the weekly card and extend offline verification
notes: Restored the Kodub weekly card with a full uncropped image, larger countdown and clearer personal-best spacing.
Made the Rolling Hills Racer reward and no-reset message easier to read.

entries.title: Fix live Kodub card spacing and title wrapping
notes: Fixed oversized gaps in the Kodub weekly card and improved title wrapping without resizing the artwork.

entries.title: Balance weekly card spacing without changing its size
notes: The Kodub weekly card has balanced spacing and clearer groups for track details, timing and rewards.
